note: Owner-declared SOLD list — cars Jerry has confirmed sold before DealerCenter has been updated. The OAP feed carries no status column, so a car stays in the feed until it is marked sold in DC; until then the site would keep showing it for sale. A VIN listed here is subtracted from the active feed set by operations/build_vehicles_json.py, so dc-inventory.json omits it and build-inventory.js soldifies it like any other feed-absent car: off the inventory grid at once, VDP kept as a SOLD page (200 OK) for SEO, absent from the Google Merchant feed. This is a BRIDGE, not a permanent hide — it is honored only while DC still lists the VIN, and is pruned automatically the moment the VIN drops out of the feed for real. Distinct from hold-vins.json, which hides an Inbound/recon unit with no SOLD page at all.
